purpose: One continuous experimental campaign: stabilize the existing whole-body MPC's stopping objective, diagnose matched-input dynamics, establish original project-physics execution, and complete longer uninterrupted missions before joint PANN/PPO integration.

frozen_reference.interpretation: The route was traversed without fall or planner fatal, but continuous terminal stability lasted at most 0.25s. Reuse this historical nominal result; do not rerun it to inflate samples.
frozen_reference.preserve: R1/R2/S0, all historical S1 configurations, source and raw results remain unchanged.

upstream.patch_status: Applied with patch -p1 to actual retained upstream source; quadruped.cc recompiled and libmjpc/agent_server relinked, build exit 0.

execution.transport: Reuse the existing SSH/tmux execution arrangement authorized and used in R6.
execution.preserve: Official XML transport, explicit affine PD 60/5, home control seed, 20 fixed t=0 planning calls, fixed-plane opt-in, complete gait tables, head-offset mapping and continuous heading.
execution.runtime: Record actual binary/source/config/model hashes and returned prediction times. Keep logical and wall time separate; finer prediction is not an NX realtime claim.
execution.pipeline_change: The old one-G0 pipeline and hard-coded 8/2/3 limits must follow this campaign configuration. Continue through the prescribed stages and evidence-based development; do not close after one failure or request a new round for each small correction.

startup.policy_seed: home keyframe ctrl after restoring home data; preserve nullptr behavior without home.
startup.ground_height_enable_condition: Adapter confirms the actual floor is a world-static horizontal plane; write its world height as one scalar.
startup.G1_ground_height_m: Read the actual project floor; do not assume zero.
startup.state_and_goal: Hold the actual initial qpos/qvel/time, complete Stand settings and initial mission goal fixed.
retain: home ctrl and pre-optimization nominal seed action
each of the 20 best trajectories: states, actions, times and iteration number
each initial action and the final feedback action before the first physical step
all initialization errors and subsequent physical failures
startup.horizon_cost: get_total_cost() is a current-state cost, not the optimized horizon return; never label it horizon convergence.
startup.success_meaning: Initialization completion is not standing or mission success.

stationary_objective.upright_residual: [R02,R12,R22-1], the trunk z-axis minus the world z-axis; keep yaw Orientation separate.
stationary_objective.norm: quadratic; transparent first engineering setting normalized by the original terminal tolerances, not a learned or proven-optimal weight
stationary_objective.horizon_scope: Every predicted state including the final cost. No learned terminal critic or new optimizer.
stationary_objective.other_modes: When the switch is off or mode/gait is not Quadruped/Stand, retain the old Upright behavior and set the new velocity residuals to zero.
stationary_objective.original_Angmom: Correct the source sensor type to subtreeangmom, keep its weight zero, and do not confuse whole-body angular momentum with base angular velocity.
stationary_objective.runner_mapping: Pass new cost names to set_cost_weights, not set_task_parameters; copy the added user sensors into G1 and retain their ordering.
stationary_objective.calibration_rule: Do not grid-search gains/costs. A further change must explain the observed velocity, attitude, force, or solver behavior and be recorded before the next full development mission.
stationary_objective.velocity_coordinates: freejoint qvel[0:3] is world-frame linear velocity; qvel[3:6] is body-frame angular velocity, not Euler-angle rates. The isotropic norms match the original terminal checks.
stationary_objective.upright_norm: Retain the existing smooth norm 6 and its parameter; only the Upright residual vector changes. The new velocity terms alone use quadratic norm 0.

prediction_settings.rationale: Default refsafe makes positive solref time constant >=2*dt. G1's original .002s is clamped to .02s by .01s prediction. The .001s candidate retains .002s without changing the actual floor. Turning off MakeDifferentiable retains native prediction contact rather than changing d0=.99 to zero.
prediction_settings.limits: Retain refsafety and the actual plant. Read the realized horizon: 512 knots cap .0002s prediction to about .1022s; do not silently truncate a claimed .35s horizon.
prediction_settings.warning: implicitfast handles actuator velocity-dependent forces but not constraint forces implicitly. Native-contact finite differences may be harder; neither setting is guaranteed to solve the mission.

matched_input_replay.source: Reuse saved R6 plan_states/plan_actions/plan_times on the execution host; do not redownload an archive to the user's PC.
matched_input_replay.selection: Every 25th saved planning origin with a complete horizon, plus the first available planning origin after each phase transition.
matched_input_replay.input: The saved plan's applied joint targets, zero-order held over its original .01s intervals, identically for every replica. No new feedback or replanning in any replica.
matched_input_replay.initial_state: Same saved plan_states[0], time and model-specific auxiliary state. Initialize missing warmstart consistently and disclose missing recorded state; no bitwise-fidelity claim.
matched_input_replay.reference: A replica of the actual plant model/contact/integrator at its original physical dt, driven by that same saved plan input. This is a counterfactual same-input reference, not the historical re-planned future.
matched_input_replay.metrics: Position/orientation, linear/angular velocity, torque and contact response at common times; separate d0, dt and integrator effects.
matched_input_replay.real_input_caution: If also replaying the actual 500Hz targets, preserve their 2ms update schedule on both sides. Do not downsample or interpolate one side and call the difference a pure dynamics error.
matched_input_replay.continuation: This is diagnosis using existing full-task evidence. It is not a standalone deliverable or smoke-test gate; proceed to complete missions in this same campaign. Repeat on the first G1 full-mission record before freezing its configuration.

G0_author_native.physical_model: Retain the author mass, inertia, passive joints, native collisions and contacts.
G0_author_native.actuator_force_limits: Retain author unbounded force; do not claim project torque-limit coverage.

preserve_physics: joint names and physical joint ranges
actuator gear relationship and original torque limits
initial qpos/qvel except the nine declared physical yaw or base-velocity conditions
original native rigid floor and contact solref/solimp/margin
G1_project_limits.permitted_model_adaptation: Nonphysical task sites/sensors/name maps and explicit joint-target PD only.
G1_project_limits.joint_target_limits: Original per-joint physical position ranges, mapped by name.
G1_project_limits.actuator_mapping: Identical gear, target bounds and original force/torque limits in predictor and plant; no unmatched post-planning clipping.

G0_named_arms.purpose: Isolate the declared numerical/contact prediction change.

development.G0_reference: Reuse the frozen R6 O=0,N=0 nominal record. New arms execute the original complete task, not isolated stand clips.
development.G0_to_G1: A new G0 original mission success establishes author-model feasibility; the N-only arm need not pass. Select with explicit velocity/holding/compute evidence, not a lucky final frame.
development.G1_start: Prefer ON when it has passed the original G0 mission. If ON failed but another arm passed, use the observed full-mission and matched-input evidence to make a justified revision or enter G1 with the successful arm; do not mechanically transfer a known failed setting. Preserve the project's physical model and original torque limits. G1 native-contact/refsafe differences still require explicit analysis and treatment. Handle justified prediction changes inside the combined development budget; never silently soften the plant.
development.allowed_changes: Evidence-based stationary cost, state/actuator/constraint semantics, and native prediction numerical settings. Each physical attempt is a complete mission and is retained.
development.forbidden_changes: Relaxing task thresholds, hiding failed starts, changing G1 mass/contact/torque limits to get success, blind grids, controller/platform replacement or new RL training.

single_mission_protocol.completion_and_hold: Record the first original mission-completion time separately. If it completes early, retain the same physical state and Stand controller through t=60 for sustained-hold observation. Later instability remains in the hold outcome and cannot be omitted.
single_mission_protocol.deterministic_scope: Nine specified physical initial conditions, not nine stochastic optimizer seeds or independent material samples.
single_mission_protocol.formal_freeze: One source/binary/controller configuration per formal cohort; reuse identical development nominal once and retain every failure.

long_mission_protocol.stop_at_each_endpoint: Use the original position/velocity/angular-velocity/roll-pitch/contact tolerances with 2s continuous stability. Heading target is the current travel heading during the stop; then turn continuously for the next leg.
long_mission_protocol.continuous_state: No reset of qpos/qvel, control policy, contact state, or initialization between legs/laps. The home endpoint must explicitly turn back toward +x before another outbound leg; do not loop a yaw=0 Mission after returning at yaw~pi.
long_mission_protocol.success: Five actual round trips completed by t=270 without original physical failure; remain at the endpoint through t=300 and meet the original continuous 2s stable condition at the end. Report all intervening 30s hold statistics and interruptions, even when the run passes.
long_mission_protocol.counting: Each 300s trace is one episode; its ten arrivals are correlated events, not ten independent trials.

campaign_budget.counting: 8 development + 12 frozen evaluation + at most one justified revised 12-condition evaluation. Exact reuse reduces actual starts. All early failures, missing records and superseded attempts count. Caps are not quotas.
campaign_budget.revision: Complete the specified cohort, or interrupt only for a demonstrated shared implementation defect that makes further identical failures uninformative. One evidence-based revision may be made, then rerun all nine original-task and three long-task conditions under the new common frozen version. Preserve both cohorts.
campaign_budget.stop: Finish when the specified campaign scope is complete, or report an actual unresolved prerequisite/runtime failure or budget exhaustion. Caps are not quotas. Do not treat absence of a spelling/interface bug after the first control failure as a reason to close the campaign.

joint_baseline_exit.minimum_supported_domain: A successful G1 nominal original mission plus successful G1 nominal uninterrupted 300s mission permits freezing a limited-domain MPC execution basis for PANN + standard PPO integration.
joint_baseline_exit.full_coverage: 9/9 original missions and 3/3 long missions establish only the prescribed deterministic coverage.
joint_baseline_exit.partial_coverage: Publish the exact successful domain and every failure. Additional edge-condition perfection and novelty proof are not prerequisites for beginning the next joint baseline on the supported domain.
joint_baseline_exit.scope: This campaign adds no PANN/PPO training or hardware execution and does not prove terrain-memory innovation. Return to the joint baseline after obtaining usable execution evidence rather than scheduling another generic MPC cleanup round.
joint_baseline_exit.learning_order: After this campaign, freeze existing PANN parameters, train standard PPO in the same Actor-to-MPC-to-robot loop, and freeze the Actor for evaluation. No PPO has been trained in this R7 plan and no training starts in this campaign.

required: one run index with code/config/model/binary and all actual attempts
one compact same-input dynamics comparison, separate from best-vs-replanned-future discrepancy
full original-task outcomes and first completion times plus post-completion hold
all nine physical initial conditions and all three long outcomes, including skipped stages with concrete reasons
continuous 500Hz state/target/torque/actual foot-force data and complete success/failure videos
best predicted tail velocities, physical force/velocity behavior, same-input errors and actual horizon span
per-arrival stopping times, uninterrupted stability intervals, lap counts and drift
real planning/feedback/physics timing and deadline misses; startup counted separately
outputs.publication: Commit source/config/compact evidence. Upload only new large arrays and full videos directly from the execution host to GitHub Release, verify size/digest, and end.

forbidden: defensive programming or generic silent fallback frameworks
new unit/mock/smoke/import/shape tests or unrelated regression matrices
automatically stopping after a single local correction
changing original task success/failure definitions to relabel R6
altering G1 physical limits or claiming G0 is G1
treating long-trace arrivals as independent samples
new neural training, hardware activation or user-PC archiving
